outcome: Incidence of transient tachypnea of the newborn (TTN)
cohort: 306 term newborns: 156 hospitalized with TTN and 150 healthy controls.
finding: Infants born via electively induced vaginal delivery had significantly higher rates of TTN compared to those born via elective cesarean section or spontaneous vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Infants born via electively induced vaginal delivery had significantly higher rates of TTN compared to other delivery methods.
